x: 资源有限，而人的欲望几乎无限，所以必须做选择。 基础概念 决策 入门 稀缺是经济学的起点。它不是说「东西很少」，而是说相对于所有人的欲望，任何资源都不够分。时间、注意力、土地、清洁空气都稀缺，因此每一份资源用在某处，就意味着别处得不到。经济学研究的正是「在稀缺条件下如何分配」。 一个月工资只有一万元：交房租就不能全存下来，买电脑就少一次旅行。钱是稀缺的，所以要排序。
xEn: Resources are limited while wants are not, so choices must be made. Foundations Choice Intro Scarcity is where economics begins. It does not mean goods are rare; it means that relative to all human wants, no resource is ever enough. Time, attention, land and clean air are all scarce, so using a resource one way means it cannot be used another way. Economics studies how allocation happens under scarcity. A monthly salary of 10,000: paying rent means less saving, buying a laptop means one less trip. Money is scarce, so priorities are needed.

x: 要得到一样东西，往往必须放弃另一样东西。 基础概念 决策 因为稀缺，任何选择都是取舍。个人在「工作与闲暇」之间取舍，企业在「成本与质量」之间取舍，政府在「效率与公平」之间取舍。承认取舍，是避免「什么都想要」式空谈的第一道门槛。 一门选修课选了经济学，就少了同一时段的摄影课；多睡一小时，就少一小时复习。
xEn: To get one thing, you usually have to give up another. Foundations Choice Because of scarcity, every choice is a trade-off: individuals trade work against leisure, firms trade cost against quality, governments trade efficiency against equity. Acknowledging trade-offs is the first defence against promises that everything can be had at once. Choosing an economics elective means missing the photography class in the same slot; one more hour of sleep is one hour less of revision.

x: 为了得到某样东西而放弃的最有价值的其他选择。 基础概念 决策 微观 机会成本不等于花掉的钱，而等于「被放弃的最好选项」。它可以包含时间、精力、情绪甚至未来的可能性。做决策时真正该比较的，是「做这件事」相对「做另一件最好的事」的差额，而不是只看账面支出。 用一小时打游戏的成本，可能是这一小时本可以赚到的钱、学到的东西或休息恢复的精力。
xEn: The value of the best alternative you give up. Foundations Choice Micro Opportunity cost is not the money spent but the best forgone alternative — including time, effort, mood and future options. Good decisions compare doing this against doing the best alternative, not merely against the cash outlay. The cost of an hour of gaming is the money, learning or rest that hour could have produced.

x: 决策看的是「多做一单位」带来的额外收益与成本。 基础概念 决策 微观 理性选择很少是「要不要做这件事」，而是「还要不要再多做一点」。只要多一单位的边际收益大于边际成本，就应该继续；反之则停。边际分析解释了为什么「平均成本很低」也可能不值得扩张。 自助餐已经吃回本了，是否再拿一份取决于「多一口的满足」是否大于「撑得难受」的代价。
xEn: Decisions hinge on the extra benefit and cost of one more unit. Foundations Choice Micro Rational choice is rarely all-or-nothing: it asks whether to do one more unit. Keep going while marginal benefit exceeds marginal cost, and stop when it does not. This is why a low average cost does not automatically justify expanding. At a buffet you have already got your money's worth; whether to take one more plate depends on whether the extra bite beats the discomfort.

x: 人们会对奖励与惩罚作出反应，规则一变，行为就变。 基础概念 制度 机制设计 激励是经济学最有解释力的工具之一。政策、价格、税收、罚款、KPI 都是激励设计。关键难点在于：激励往往带来意料之外的应对方式（如按代码行数考核就会写出更多冗余代码）。 超市塑料袋收费后使用量骤降；公司按加班时长算绩效，办公室就没人准时走。
xEn: People respond to rewards and penalties; change the rules and behaviour changes. Foundations Institutions Mechanism design Incentives are among the most powerful explanatory tools in economics: prices, taxes, fines and KPIs are all incentive designs. The hard part is unintended adaptation — paying per line of code simply produces more lines of code. Charging for plastic bags cuts their use; paying by hours worked keeps desks occupied after hours.

x: 已经花掉且无法收回的成本，不该影响下一步决策。 基础概念 决策 行为 理性决策只比较「从现在往后的成本与收益」。但由于厌恶浪费，人常因为「都投入这么多了」而继续投入，这就是沉没成本谬误。识别它的办法是问：如果今天从零开始，我还会选这条路吗？ 电影很难看，但「票都买了」让人硬撑两小时——票钱是沉没成本，时间不是。
xEn: Costs already spent and unrecoverable should not drive the next decision. Foundations Choice Behavior Rational decisions compare only future costs and benefits. Because waste feels bad, people keep investing because of what is already spent — the sunk-cost fallacy. The test: if I started from zero today, would I still choose this path? A bad film plus a bought ticket keeps people seated for two hours: the ticket is sunk, the time is not.

x: 价格越高，愿意卖的人越多、想买的人越少。 供给需求 微观 需求曲线向下倾斜：价格越低，买得越多。供给曲线向上倾斜：价格越高，卖得越多。两条曲线相交决定成交价格与数量。几乎所有价格现象——从房租到机票到菜价——都可以先用供需框架拆一遍。 节前机票贵，是因为同期出行需求暴增而座位数量基本固定。
xEn: Higher prices bring more sellers and fewer buyers. Supply & Demand Micro Demand slopes down: the cheaper it is, the more is bought. Supply slopes up: the higher the price, the more is offered. Their intersection sets price and quantity, making supply and demand the first lens for nearly any price puzzle, from rent to airfare to vegetables. Holiday airfares jump because travel demand spikes while seats are fixed.

x: 供给量正好等于需求量时的那个价格。 供给需求 微观 价格高于均衡点会积压库存，卖方降价；低于均衡点会排队抢购，买方加价。这种自发调整就是「看不见的手」的日常版本。现实市场会有摩擦（信息、管制、垄断），因此均衡常是方向而非精确落点。 二手平台上同一款手机标价过高没人问，卖家自然会降价直到有人接手。
xEn: The price at which quantity supplied equals quantity demanded. Supply & Demand Micro Above equilibrium, unsold stock forces sellers to cut prices; below it, queues let buyers bid up. This self-correction is the everyday version of the invisible hand. Real markets have frictions — information, regulation, monopoly — so equilibrium is a direction, not an exact landing point. An overpriced phone on a second-hand platform attracts no messages until the seller cuts the price.

x: 价格变一点，需求量变多少——变得多就是有弹性。 供给需求 微观 定价 弹性衡量的是「敏感度」。替代品多、非必需、占支出比例大的商品通常更有弹性（如某品牌饮料）；替代品少、必需的商品则缺乏弹性（如胰岛素、汽油短期需求）。弹性直接决定涨价能否增加收入。 地铁票涨价后乘客基本不变（缺乏弹性），而某款奶茶涨价后销量暴跌（富有弹性）。
xEn: How much quantity responds to a price change: a big response means elastic. Supply & Demand Micro Pricing Elasticity measures sensitivity. Goods with many substitutes, that are discretionary or take a large share of spending tend to be elastic; goods with few substitutes and inelastic demand — insulin, petrol in the short run — are not. Elasticity decides whether a price rise actually raises revenue. Raising metro fares barely changes ridership (inelastic), while a milk-tea brand raising prices can lose most of its sales (elastic).

x: 价格被压在均衡之外，就会出现卖不掉或买不到。 供给需求 微观 管制 价格高于均衡 → 供大于求（过剩）；价格低于均衡 → 供不应求（短缺）。价格管制、补贴、限价都可能制造这两种结果，而市场会用其他方式补偿：排队、黄牛、配给、走后门、质量下降。 票价限价后出现黄牛；房租管制长期实行后，房东减少维护、房源供给萎缩。
xEn: Hold price away from equilibrium and you get either unsold stock or queues. Supply & Demand Micro Regulation Price above equilibrium creates surplus; below it creates shortage. Price controls, subsidies and caps can generate either, and markets compensate in other ways: queues, scalpers, rationing, favours, or lower quality. Ticket price caps breed scalpers; long-standing rent controls reduce maintenance and shrink the rental stock.

x: 你的行为影响了第三方，但没有为此付费或得到补偿。 市场结构 市场失灵 政策 负外部性（污染、噪音、拥堵）让社会成本高于私人成本，市场会生产过多；正外部性（疫苗、教育、研发）让社会收益高于私人收益，市场会生产过少。对策通常是征税、补贴、产权界定或直接管制。 工厂排污自己省了钱，下游居民承担健康成本；这就是需要环保税或排放权交易的原因。
xEn: Your action affects a third party without payment or compensation. Market Structure Market failure Policy Negative externalities (pollution, noise, congestion) make social cost exceed private cost, so markets overproduce; positive ones (vaccines, education, R&D) make social benefit exceed private benefit, so markets underproduce. Common remedies: taxes, subsidies, property rights, regulation. A factory saves money by dumping waste while downstream residents bear the health cost — the case for pollution taxes or permit trading.

x: 所有人都能用、且很难阻止别人搭便车的物品。 市场结构 市场失灵 公共政策 公共品具备「非排他性」与「非竞争性」：国防、路灯、基础研究、公共广播。因为无法阻止搭便车，私人不愿提供，通常由政府或集体行动供给。难点在于「愿意付多少」难以显示真实偏好。 小区里没人愿意独自出钱装公共监控，但装上后所有住户都受益。
xEn: Goods everyone can use and no one can easily be excluded from. Market Structure Market failure Public policy Public goods are non-excludable and non-rival: national defence, street lights, basic research, public broadcasting. Since free-riding cannot be stopped, private provision is scarce and governments or collective action step in. The hard part is eliciting true willingness to pay. No single resident will fund CCTV alone, yet once installed every household benefits.

x: 从完全竞争到垄断，卖家的数量决定了定价权。 市场结构 微观 竞争 完全竞争（众多小卖家、同质产品）中企业只能是价格接受者；垄断（唯一卖家）可以定价但受需求约束；现实中更多是垄断竞争与寡头（品牌差异化、少数几家博弈）。集中度、进入壁垒、产品差异是关键变量。 街边小吃摊几乎没有定价权，而手机操作系统市场长期只有两家主要玩家。
xEn: From perfect competition to monopoly, the number of sellers sets pricing power. Market Structure Micro Competition In perfect competition many small sellers of identical goods are price takers; a monopolist sets price but is limited by demand. Reality is mostly monopolistic competition and oligopoly — differentiation plus a few players. Concentration, entry barriers and differentiation are the key variables. Street food stalls have almost no pricing power, while mobile operating systems have long had only two main players.

x: 就算你样样不如人，专注于相对成本最低的事，双方仍能获益。 国际贸易 贸易 分工 比较优势看的是「机会成本」而非绝对效率。李嘉图指出：只要两国生产两种商品的相对成本不同，专业化分工并交换就能扩大总产出。这是支持贸易互利最核心、也最容易被误读的论证。 律师打字也比助理快，但律师每打一小时字就少赚一小时咨询费，于是让助理打字对双方都更好。
xEn: Even if you are worse at everything, specialising where your relative cost is lowest benefits both sides. Trade & Globalization Trade Division of labour Comparative advantage compares opportunity costs, not absolute productivity. Ricardo showed that whenever two countries face different relative costs, specialisation plus exchange raises total output — the core argument for mutual gains from trade, and the most misread one. A lawyer may type faster than an assistant, but every hour typing costs an hour of billable advice — delegating makes both better off.

x: 一个国家在一年内新生产出的最终商品与服务总价值。 宏观 宏观 指标 GDP 有三种等价算法：生产法、收入法、支出法（C+I+G+NX）。它是「流量」而非「存量」，衡量的是产出而非财富或幸福感。人均 GDP 常被用作发展水平近似指标，但它遗漏家务劳动、环境损耗与分配状况。 自己做饭不计入 GDP，同一个人去餐厅吃饭就计入——因为后者发生了市场交易。
xEn: The total value of final goods and services produced within a country in a year. Macro Macro Indicator GDP can be computed three equivalent ways: production, income, or expenditure (C+I+G+NX). It is a flow, not a stock — output, not wealth or wellbeing. GDP per capita is a rough proxy for development that ignores unpaid work, environmental damage and distribution. Cooking at home is not counted in GDP; buying the same meal at a restaurant is, because a market transaction occurs.

x: 整体物价水平持续上涨，钱的购买力持续下降。 宏观 宏观 货币 温和通胀（多数央行目标约 2%）通常伴随经济增长；恶性通胀则摧毁货币信用。主要成因包括需求拉动、成本推动与货币因素。通胀对存款人、固定收入者不利，对债务人有利，因此也是一种财富再分配。 十年前 10 元能吃一顿午饭，现在可能只够一杯饮料：不是饭变贵了，而是钱变薄了。
xEn: A sustained rise in the general price level, eroding the value of money. Macro Macro Money Moderate inflation (many central banks target around 2%) usually accompanies growth; hyperinflation destroys a currency's credibility. Common drivers are demand-pull, cost-push and monetary factors. Inflation hurts savers and fixed-income earners and helps borrowers — it redistributes wealth. Ten yuan once bought lunch and now buys a drink: the meal did not get fancier, the money got thinner.

x: 有劳动能力、愿意工作却找不到工作的人所占的比例。 宏观 宏观 就业 失业分摩擦性（换工作间隙）、结构性（技能与岗位错配）、周期性（需求不足）。统计口径很关键：放弃找工作的人不计入失业率，因此失业率下降不总等于就业变好。奥肯法则描述了失业与产出的经验关系。 工厂自动化后，原本的流水线工人技能不再匹配新岗位，这属于结构性失业。
xEn: The share of people able and willing to work who cannot find a job. Macro Macro Labour Unemployment is frictional (between jobs), structural (skills mismatch) or cyclical (weak demand). Definitions matter: people who stop looking are excluded, so a falling rate is not always good news. Okun's law links unemployment to output empirically. When a plant automates, former assembly-line workers no longer match available jobs — structural unemployment.

x: 人均产出的长期提高，主要来自生产率与技术进步。 宏观 宏观 长期 长期增长靠的不是「多干活」，而是「同样投入产出更多」。资本积累、人力资本、技术进步与制度质量是四大来源。复利效应下，几个百分点的年均增速差异，几十年后会变成生活水平的天壤之别。 年均 7% 与年均 2% 的差距，30 年后是约 7.6 倍与 1.8 倍产出的差别。
xEn: A long-run rise in output per person, driven mainly by productivity and technology. Macro Macro Long run Long-run growth comes not from working more but from producing more with the same input. Capital accumulation, human capital, technology and institutional quality are the four sources. Because of compounding, a few percentage points of annual growth becomes a vastly different standard of living within decades. Over 30 years, 7% annual growth multiplies output about 7.6 times versus 1.8 times at 2%.

x: 被普遍接受的交易媒介、计价单位与价值储藏。 货币金融 货币 金融 货币的三大职能缺一不可：交易媒介解决物物交换的「双重巧合」难题，计价单位降低比较成本，价值储藏让收入与支出分离。现代货币多数是信用货币，其价值来自国家信用与法定地位，而非背后的黄金。 没有货币时，面包师要用面包换鞋，必须刚好找到一个想要面包的鞋匠；有了货币就无需巧合。
xEn: A generally accepted medium of exchange, unit of account and store of value. Money & Finance Money Finance Money performs three functions: as a medium of exchange it solves the double coincidence of wants; as a unit of account it lowers comparison costs; as a store of value it separates earning from spending. Most modern money is fiat, backed by state credibility rather than gold. Without money a baker must find a shoemaker who wants bread right now; with money no coincidence is needed.

x: 资金的价格，也是把未来的钱折算到今天的折扣率。 货币金融 货币 金融 名义利率 = 实际利率 + 预期通胀（费雪方程）。利率升高会抑制借贷与投资、吸引资金流入、压低资产估值；利率降低则相反。央行通过政策利率影响整个利率体系，再传导到房贷、企业融资与汇率。 房贷利率从 4% 升到 6%，同样一笔贷款月供明显增加，购房需求随之降温。
xEn: The price of funds, and the discount rate that translates future money into today's value. Money & Finance Money Finance The Fisher equation splits nominal rates into real rates plus expected inflation. Higher rates discourage borrowing and investment, attract capital and compress valuations; lower rates do the reverse. Central banks move a policy rate that transmits to mortgages, corporate funding and exchange rates. A mortgage rate rising from 4% to 6% noticeably raises monthly payments, cooling housing demand.

x: 发行货币、制定利率、充当最后贷款人的机构。 货币金融 货币 政策 央行的核心目标通常是物价稳定，许多还兼顾就业与金融稳定。工具包括政策利率、公开市场操作、准备金要求以及量化宽松。独立性与可信度至关重要：市场相信央行会控通胀，加息才不必过猛。 危机时央行向银行体系注入流动性，防止挤兑演变成系统性崩盘。
xEn: The institution that issues money, sets interest rates and acts as lender of last resort. Money & Finance Money Policy Central banks usually target price stability, with mandates that often include employment and financial stability. Tools include the policy rate, open market operations, reserve requirements and quantitative easing. Independence and credibility matter: if markets believe inflation will be controlled, less tightening is needed. In a crisis a central bank injects liquidity into the banking system so a run does not become a systemic collapse.

x: 每个人都已选定策略，且没人能通过单方面改变而变得更好。 行为与博弈 博弈 策略 纳什均衡是一种「稳定状态」，但它不保证结果最优——囚徒困境的均衡对双方都更差。它也不保证唯一，博弈可能存在多个均衡，此时「谁先行动、如何沟通、习惯如何」决定了落点。 两家公司都不打价格战是均衡；但若都怀疑对方会降价，先降价也可能成为另一个均衡。
xEn: A set of strategies where no player gains by changing alone. Behavior & Games Games Strategy Nash equilibrium is a stable state, but not necessarily a good one: the prisoner's dilemma equilibrium is worse for both. Nor is it always unique — with multiple equilibria, who moves first, how players communicate and shared habits decide which one is reached. Two firms both holding prices is an equilibrium; if each fears the other will cut, pre-emptive cutting can be an equilibrium too.

x: 同样金额，失去的痛苦大于得到的快乐。 行为与博弈 行为 心理 前景理论的核心发现之一：人对损失的心理权重约为同等收益的 1.5–2.5 倍。这解释了为什么人死守亏损股票、为什么「限时优惠」有效、为什么改革常常遭遇强烈阻力——既得利益的失去被放大。 捡到 100 元的开心，抵不过丢掉 100 元的难受；这会让人过度回避风险。
xEn: Losing hurts more than gaining the same amount feels good. Behavior & Games Behavior Psychology A central finding of prospect theory: losses carry roughly 1.5–2.5 times the psychological weight of equivalent gains. This explains holding losing positions, the power of limited-time discounts, and why reforms meet fierce resistance — losses to vested interests loom larger. Finding 100 feels lighter than losing 100 feels heavy, which pushes people towards excessive risk aversion.

x: 名义上向谁征税，和实际上谁承担，是两件事。 微观 微观 税收 税收负担最终由买卖双方按弹性分摊：谁更缺乏弹性（更难替代），谁承担更多。向卖方征税可能导致价格上升由买方承担，向买方征税也可能压低卖方净价。因此「让企业交税」不等于「企业真的承担」。 对房东征税，如果住房供给缺乏弹性，税负更多落在房东身上；反之可能转成更高租金。
xEn: Who is taxed by law and who bears the burden in practice are different questions. Micro Micro Taxation The burden splits according to elasticity: the less elastic side — the one that can less easily substitute — bears more. Taxing sellers can raise prices paid by buyers; taxing buyers can cut net prices received by sellers. So 'making firms pay' does not mean firms truly bear it. Taxing landlords shifts more of the burden onto them when housing supply is inelastic; otherwise it can reappear as higher rent.

x: 人人可用却无人拥有的资源，会被过度使用直至枯竭。 市场结构 公共资源 治理 当使用收益归个人、损耗成本由群体分担时，每个人的理性行为叠加成集体灾难：过度放牧、渔业枯竭、地下水超采。奥斯特罗姆的研究表明，除了私有化与国家管制，社区自治规则也能有效治理公共池塘资源。 共享单车早期无人约束地投放与私占，最终车辆损坏率极高、企业退出。
xEn: Resources open to all and owned by none are overused until depleted. Market Structure Commons Governance When benefits are private and costs are shared, individually rational use adds up to collective ruin: overgrazing, depleted fisheries, falling water tables. Ostrom showed that beyond privatisation and state control, community-designed rules can govern common-pool resources well. Early dockless bike-sharing saw unlimited dumping and private locking, ending in extreme damage rates and market exit.

x: 交易一方知道得更多，市场可能因劣质品驱逐优质品而萎缩。 市场结构 市场失灵 信息 信息不对称分两类：「逆向选择」发生在成交前（买家分不清质量，只肯出平均价），「道德风险」发生在成交后（有兜底方时行为变得更冒险）。解决方式包括信号（学历、认证、保修）、筛选（免赔额、分级定价）与第三方验证（评级、质检、平台担保）。 二手车市场上，卖家清楚车况而买家不清楚，买家压价使好车退出，最终市场只剩次品。
xEn: When one side knows more, markets can shrink as bad products drive out good ones. Market Structure Market failure Information Two forms: adverse selection before contracting (buyers cannot judge quality and pay an average price) and moral hazard after (protection makes behaviour riskier). Remedies include signalling (credentials, certification, warranties), screening (deductibles, tiered pricing) and third-party verification (ratings, inspection, platform guarantees). In used cars the seller knows the condition, buyers discount, good cars exit and the market fills with lemons.

x: 把全国一年新做出来的东西和提供的服务按价格加总，得到的那个大数字。 宏观指标 一定时期内一国境内生产的全部最终商品与服务的市场价值总和。
xEn: Add up everything newly produced in the country in a year at market prices. Macro indicators The market value of all final goods and services produced within a country in a period.

x: 把普通人常买的一堆东西记下来，看这一堆东西一共贵了多少。 宏观指标 衡量一篮子居民消费品与服务价格水平变动的指数，是观测通胀最常用的指标。
xEn: Track the total cost of a typical household shopping basket and see how much it rose. Macro indicators An index tracking the price of a fixed basket of household goods and services; the standard inflation gauge.

x: 今年的东西比去年贵了几个百分点。 宏观指标 物价水平相对于上年同期的百分比变化，通常以 CPI 同比增速衡量。
xEn: How many percent more expensive things are than a year ago. Macro indicators The percentage change in the price level versus a year earlier, usually measured by CPI year-on-year.

x: 东西越来越便宜，听起来是好事，但大家会一直等更便宜，于是生意更难做。 宏观指标 整体物价水平持续下降的现象，往往伴随需求疲弱与债务负担加重。
xEn: Prices keep falling — sounds good, until everyone waits for cheaper and business gets harder. Macro indicators A sustained fall in the general price level, often accompanied by weak demand and heavier real debt.

x: 既找不到工作，东西又越来越贵，是最难受的组合。 宏观指标 经济停滞（高失业、低增长）与高通胀同时出现的状态。
xEn: Jobs are scarce and prices keep rising: the worst combination. Macro indicators High inflation occurring together with stagnation — weak growth and high unemployment.

x: 想工作、能工作但没工作的人，占所有想工作的人的比例。 宏观指标 失业人口占劳动力人口（就业者 + 正在寻找工作者）的比例。
xEn: The share of people who want and can work but have no job, out of all who want to work. Macro indicators Unemployed people as a share of the labour force (employed plus actively job-seeking).

x: 政府多花钱或少花钱、多收税或少收税，来给经济踩油门或刹车。 宏观政策 政府通过支出与税收调节总需求与经济活动的政策。
xEn: The government spends or taxes more or less to speed up or slow down the economy. Macro policy Government use of spending and taxation to influence aggregate demand and activity.

x: 央行决定借钱贵不贵，从而影响大家贷不贷、花不花。 宏观政策 中央银行通过利率、准备金与资产购买等手段调节货币与信贷条件的政策。
xEn: The central bank decides how expensive borrowing is, which shapes whether people borrow and spend. Macro policy Central bank actions on interest rates, reserves and asset purchases to steer money and credit conditions.

x: 一年里政府花的比收的多，差的那部分要借钱补上。 宏观政策 政府年度支出超过收入的差额，通常通过发行债券融资。
xEn: When the government spends more than it collects in a year, it borrows the difference. Macro policy The excess of annual government spending over revenue, usually financed by issuing bonds.

x: 政府欠的钱总共多少，通常看它相当于几年全国产出。 宏观政策 政府历年累积未偿还的借款总额，通常以占 GDP 比重衡量其规模。
xEn: How much the government owes in total, usually expressed as a share of annual output. Macro policy The accumulated stock of government borrowing outstanding, usually scaled by GDP.

x: 央行在市场上买债就是往体系里放钱，卖债就是把钱收回来。 央行工具 央行在市场上买卖有价证券以投放或回笼流动性、影响短期利率的操作。
xEn: When the central bank buys bonds it puts money into the system; selling takes money out. Central bank tools Central bank purchases or sales of securities to inject or drain liquidity and steer short-term rates.

x: 银行每收 100 元存款，必须留一部分不能借出去。 央行工具 银行必须按存款的一定比例留存的准备金，比率越高可贷资金越少。
xEn: For every 100 in deposits, banks must keep part aside and cannot lend it out. Central bank tools The share of deposits banks must hold as reserves; a higher ratio means less to lend.

x: 利率已经降到不能再降了，央行只好直接下场大买资产继续放水。 央行工具 政策利率接近零时，央行大规模购买长期资产以压低长期利率、注入流动性的非常规手段。
xEn: With rates already near zero, the central bank buys assets directly to keep easing. Central bank tools Unconventional large-scale purchases of longer-term assets to push down long rates and inject liquidity when policy rates are near zero.

x: 想卖就能马上卖掉还不掉价，就叫流动性好。 金融概念 资产能以接近其合理价格迅速变现的能力；也指市场中资金的充裕程度。
xEn: If you can sell quickly without a price discount, liquidity is good. Finance concepts How quickly an asset can be sold near its fair value; also how abundant funds are in a market.

x: 把 1 年、5 年、10 年国债的利息画成一条线，看市场觉得未来会怎样。 金融概念 同一类债券在不同期限上的收益率连成的曲线，反映市场对利率与增长的预期。
xEn: Plot the interest on 1-, 5- and 10-year government debt to read what the market expects. Finance concepts Yields on comparable bonds across maturities, reflecting expectations for rates and growth.

x: 一块钱能换多少外币。 金融概念 一种货币兑换另一种货币的比率，由市场供求、利率差与政策共同决定。
xEn: How much foreign currency one unit of your money buys. Finance concepts The price of one currency in another, set by supply, demand, rate differentials and policy.

x: 两个利息之间差多少；差得越大，市场觉得风险越高。 金融概念 两种利率或价格之间的差额，常用来衡量风险溢价或市场紧张程度。
xEn: The gap between two interest rates; a wider gap signals more perceived risk. Finance concepts The difference between two rates or prices, often read as a risk premium or stress gauge.

x: 用自己的钱做抵押借更多钱去投资，赚得多亏得也快。 金融概念 用借来的资金放大投资规模，从而同时放大收益与亏损。
xEn: Borrowing against your own money to invest more: bigger gains, faster losses. Finance concepts Using borrowed money to enlarge a position, magnifying both gains and losses.

x: 大家买不是因为值这么多，而是因为觉得还能涨更多。 金融概念 资产价格远超其基本面价值，主要由预期继续上涨的投机需求推动。
xEn: People buy not because it is worth that much, but because they expect it to rise more. Finance concepts Prices far above fundamental value, driven mainly by speculation that they will rise further.

x: 一家倒了把一串都拖下水，最后整个系统都出问题。 金融概念 单个机构或市场的冲击通过关联网络传染，导致整个金融体系失灵的风险。
xEn: One failure drags others down until the whole system breaks. Finance concepts The risk that one shock propagates through interconnections and disables the whole financial system.

x: 管钱的总开关，负责印钞、定利率，出事时救流动性。 金融概念 负责发行货币、制定货币政策并在危机时提供最后贷款支持的公共机构。
xEn: The master switch for money: issuing currency, setting rates and providing liquidity in crises. Finance concepts The public institution that issues currency, sets monetary policy and lends last resort in crises.

x: 给借钱的人打分，分高的借钱便宜，分低的借钱贵。 金融概念 评级机构对债务人违约可能性的等级判断，直接影响其融资成本。
xEn: A score for borrowers: higher score, cheaper borrowing. Finance concepts An agency's graded judgement of default risk, which directly affects borrowing cost.

x: 借钱要付的价格，也是「明年的钱在今天值多少」的换算尺。 金融概念 借贷资金的价格，也用于把未来现金流折算为现值。
xEn: The price of borrowing, and the ruler converting next year's money into today's value. Finance concepts The price of loanable funds, also used to discount future cash flows to the present.

x: 多做一件，总共多花多少钱。 微观概念 多生产一单位产品所增加的总成本。
xEn: How much more it costs in total to make one extra unit. Micro concepts The increase in total cost from producing one more unit.

x: 做得越多，每件越便宜，所以大厂往往比小厂有优势。 微观概念 产量扩大导致单位成本下降的现象，源于固定成本摊薄与专业化。
xEn: The more you make, the cheaper each unit — which favours larger producers. Micro concepts Falling unit cost as output grows, driven by spreading fixed costs and specialisation.

x: 同样的东西，学生票便宜、临期打折、老客更贵，都是这回事。 微观概念 对同一商品向不同消费者或在不同条件下收取不同价格的做法。
xEn: Student discounts, last-minute sales and higher prices for loyal users are all this. Micro concepts Charging different prices for the same good to different buyers or under different conditions.

x: 你本来愿意出 50 元，结果只花了 30 元，赚到的 20 元就是它。 微观概念 消费者愿意支付的最高价格与实际支付价格之间的差额。
xEn: You would have paid 50 but paid 30 — the 20 is your surplus. Micro concepts The gap between the most a consumer would pay and what they actually pay.

x: 就那几家大公司在卖，谁降价都要先想别人会不会跟。 微观概念 少数几家大企业主导市场、彼此决策高度依赖的市场结构。
xEn: Only a few big sellers, and each thinks about whether rivals will follow a price cut. Micro concepts A market dominated by a few large firms whose decisions depend heavily on each other.

x: 想进场做生意，但门槛太高进不去，现有玩家就能长期收高价。 微观概念 使新企业难以进入某行业并与之竞争的因素，如牌照、专利、规模与网络效应。
xEn: High walls keep newcomers out, letting incumbents keep prices high. Micro concepts Factors that make it hard for new firms to enter and compete: licences, patents, scale, network effects.

x: 外国货进来要交一笔钱，价格就贵了。 贸易概念 对进口商品征收的税，抬高进口价、保护本国产业并可能招致对方报复。
xEn: Foreign goods pay a fee at the border, making them more expensive. Trade concepts A tax on imports that raises their price, shields domestic producers and can invite retaliation.

x: 卖出去的多还是买进来的多，两者的差。 贸易概念 一定时期内出口总额与进口总额之差，出超为顺差，入超为逆差。
xEn: Whether the country sold more abroad than it bought. Trade concepts Exports minus imports over a period: a surplus if positive, a deficit if negative.

x: 一件商品从零件到送到你手上，中间经过的所有国家和工厂。 贸易概念 从原料到成品交付所经历的一系列跨国分工与协作环节。
xEn: All the countries and factories a product passes through before reaching you. Trade concepts The sequence of cross-border steps converting raw materials into a delivered product.

x: 不看你最擅长什么，而看为了做这件事你要放弃的最少的是什么。 贸易概念 以较低机会成本生产某商品的能力，是国际贸易互利的基础。
xEn: Not what you are best at, but what you give up least to do. Trade concepts The ability to produce a good at lower opportunity cost, the basis of mutual gains from trade.

x: 先看到「原价 999」，再看「现价 499」就觉得很便宜。 行为概念 判断时过度依赖最先接触到的数字或信息，后续调整不足。
xEn: After seeing 'was 999', the 'now 499' looks like a bargain. Behavioural concepts Over-reliance on the first number or cue encountered, with insufficient adjustment.

x: 大家都买我也买，大家都跑我也跑。 行为概念 个体放弃自身判断跟随多数人行为的倾向，常放大市场波动。
xEn: Everyone buys so I buy; everyone runs so I run. Behavioural concepts The tendency to abandon private judgement and follow the crowd, often amplifying swings.

x: 同一张票，没买到时愿出 100，已买到时少于 200 不卖。 行为概念 一旦拥有某物，人们对其估值就会显著高于未拥有时。
xEn: The same ticket: you would pay 100 to buy it, but would not sell it for under 200. Behavioural concepts Once you own something, you value it noticeably more than you would if you did not.

x: 一个 0 到 1 的数字，越接近 1 说明差距越大。 统计指标 衡量收入或财富分配不平等程度的指标，0 表示完全平等，1 表示完全不平等。
xEn: A number between 0 and 1: closer to 1 means bigger gaps. Statistical indicators A measure of inequality from 0 (perfect equality) to 1 (one person takes all).

x: 吃饭花的钱占全部花销的比例，越穷这个比例一般越高。 统计指标 家庭食品支出占消费总支出的比重，通常随收入上升而下降。
xEn: The share of spending that goes to food — usually higher when income is lower. Statistical indicators Food spending as a share of total household consumption, typically falling as income rises.

x: 不看汇率多少，而看同样的钱在当地实际能买到多少东西。 统计指标 按各国物价水平调整后的汇率口径，用于跨国比较真实生活成本与产出。
xEn: Not the market rate, but how much the same money actually buys locally. Statistical indicators An exchange-rate measure adjusted for price levels, used to compare real costs and output across countries.

x: 工资涨了 5%，物价涨了 6%，那实际是变穷了。 统计指标 名义值按当期价格计算，实际值剔除物价变动，后者才反映真实购买力变化。
xEn: Wages up 5% with prices up 6% means you are actually worse off. Statistical indicators Nominal values use current prices; real values strip out price changes to show purchasing power.

x: 工厂卖货的价格先变，往往过一阵子零售价才跟着变。 宏观指标 衡量生产环节出厂价格变动的指数，常被视为 CPI 的先行指标。
xEn: Factory prices move first; shop prices tend to follow later. Macro indicators An index of factory-gate prices, often seen as a leading indicator for CPI.

x: 想卖的人和想买的人一起决定价格。 微观概念 描述价格与数量如何由卖方供给意愿和买方需求意愿共同决定的基本框架。
xEn: Sellers and buyers together determine the price. Micro concepts The framework in which price and quantity emerge from sellers' willingness to supply and buyers' willingness to buy.

x: 大家都不动的那个局面，谁单独换招都更亏。 博弈概念 所有参与者都已选定策略、且无人能通过单独改变策略而获益的稳定状态。
xEn: The standoff where anyone who moves alone ends up worse off. Game theory concepts A stable state where all players have chosen strategies and no one gains by changing alone.

x: 你看跌某只股票，就找人借来先卖掉，等它真跌了再低价买回来还掉，中间的价差就是赚的。但要是它不跌反涨，你就得用更高的价格买回来还，亏的会越涨越多、没有封顶。 金融概念 预期某资产价格将下跌时，先借入该资产卖出，待价格下跌后低价买回归还，赚取差价的交易策略；收益上限等于全部跌幅，亏损则随价格上涨而理论上没有上限。
xEn: You think a stock will fall, so you borrow and sell it now; if it drops you buy back cheap, return it and keep the gap. But if it rises instead, you must buy back higher to return it — and the loss grows the higher it climbs, with no cap. Finance concepts A strategy of borrowing an asset to sell it now, then buying it back cheaper after a price fall to return to the lender and keep the difference; profit is capped by a full drop, while losses rise without a hard ceiling as the price climbs.

x: 同一笔经济活动，可以从生产、收入、支出三个方向加总，结果必然相等。 核算 生产法 各行业增加值之和＝总产出 − 中间投入，避免重复计算。 收入法 工资 + 利息 + 租金 + 利润 + 生产税净额，即各种要素拿到手的收入。 支出法 C + I + G + NX，即消费、投资、政府支出与净出口。 名义与实际 名义 GDP 用当期价格，实际 GDP 剔除物价变动，比较不同年份必须用实际值。
xEn: The same activity can be added up from production, income or expenditure — and the totals must match. Accounting Production Sum of value added = gross output minus intermediate inputs, avoiding double counting. Income Wages + interest + rent + profit + net taxes on production: what factors of production receive. Expenditure C + I + G + NX: consumption, investment, government spending and net exports. Nominal vs real Nominal GDP uses current prices; real GDP strips out price changes and is the right basis for comparison.

x: 需求过旺、成本上升、货币过多与预期自我实现，是四条主要路径。 物价 需求拉动 总需求超过潜在产出，买家竞价推高价格。 成本推动 能源、原料、工资或汇率变动抬高生产成本，企业转嫁至售价。 货币因素 货币与信贷增速长期远超产出增速，最终表现为物价上涨。 预期自我实现 当人人预期涨价，就会提前囤货、要求加薪，把预期变成现实。
xEn: Excess demand, rising costs, too much money and self-fulfilling expectations are the four main routes. Prices Demand-pull Aggregate demand exceeds potential output, and buyers bid prices up. Cost-push Energy, input, wage or exchange-rate shocks raise costs, which firms pass on. Monetary Money and credit growing far faster than output eventually shows up in prices. Expectations When everyone expects higher prices, they stock up and demand raises, turning expectation into fact.

x: 央行只调一个政策利率，效果却要经过银行、资产价格、汇率与预期四条渠道才能到达实体。 政策 利率渠道 政策利率影响贷款与存款利率，进而影响投资与消费意愿。 资产价格 利率下降抬高股票与房产估值，通过财富效应刺激支出。 信贷渠道 银行的风险偏好与资本状况决定信贷能不能顺利投放。 汇率渠道 加息吸引资金流入、本币升值，进而影响出口竞争力。
xEn: The central bank moves one policy rate, but the effect reaches the real economy through four channels. Policy Interest rate The policy rate moves lending and deposit rates, shaping investment and consumption. Asset prices Lower rates lift equity and property valuations, and wealth effects boost spending. Credit Bank risk appetite and capital determine whether credit actually flows. Exchange rate Higher rates attract capital, appreciate the currency and affect export competitiveness.

n: 财政政策的乘数与局限
x: 政府多花一块钱，最终可能带动超过一块钱的产出，也可能被挤出私人支出而所剩无几。 政策 乘数 支出变成他人收入，再被花掉，形成连锁反应，总效果大于初始金额。 挤出效应 政府大量借债推高利率，可能压缩私人投资。 自动稳定器 累进税与失业救济在经济下行时自动扩大支出、上行时自动收缩。 时滞与效率 识别、决策、执行三重时滞，加上项目质量差异，决定最终效果。
xEn: One unit of government spending may generate more than one unit of output — or crowd out private spending and achieve little. Policy Multiplier Spending becomes someone's income, which is spent again, so the total exceeds the initial amount. Crowding out Heavy government borrowing can push rates up and displace private investment. Automatic stabilisers Progressive taxes and unemployment benefits expand automatically in downturns and contract in booms. Lags and quality Recognition, decision and implementation lags, plus project quality, determine the outcome.

x: 摩擦性、结构性、周期性失业的成因不同，对应政策也完全不同。 就业 摩擦性 换工作、找工作需要时间，属于正常的市场匹配过程。 结构性 技术或产业变迁使技能与岗位错配，短期刺激无法解决。 周期性 总需求不足导致企业裁员，需要财政与货币宽松来修复。 自然失业率 即使经济正常运转也会存在的失业水平，由摩擦与结构因素决定。
xEn: Frictional, structural and cyclical unemployment have different causes and need different policies. Labour Frictional Time needed to search and switch jobs: a normal matching process. Structural Technology or industry shifts mismatch skills and vacancies; demand stimulus cannot fix it. Cyclical Weak aggregate demand causes layoffs; fiscal and monetary easing is the remedy. Natural rate The unemployment level that persists even in a healthy economy, set by frictional and structural factors.

x: 扩张与收缩交替出现，幅度与持续时间并不规则，但机制有几条常见线索。 周期 信贷周期 宽松时加杠杆推高资产价格，收紧时去杠杆放大下行。 库存周期 企业补库存与去库存的交替，短周期波动的主要来源。 投资周期 重大技术或基础设施投资形成多年一轮的荣枯。 政策反应 逆周期调控可以平滑波动，也可能延后调整、积累风险。
xEn: Expansions and contractions alternate irregularly, yet a few mechanisms recur. Cycles Credit cycle Easy money leverages up asset prices; tightening deleverages and amplifies the downturn. Inventory Alternating inventory building and destocking drives short cycles. Investment Major technology or infrastructure waves create multi-year booms and busts. Policy response Countercyclical policy can smooth swings, or delay adjustment and build risk.

x: 价格变化是「沿曲线移动」，收入、偏好、替代品价格变化才是「整条曲线平移」。 需求供给 沿曲线移动 只有自身价格变化才导致需求量变化，其余因素不变。 曲线右移 收入上升、偏好转向、替代品涨价或买家人数增加都会推高需求。 曲线左移 互补品涨价、预期未来降价、替代品降价都会压低需求。 需求 vs 需求量 中文常混用，但前者指整条曲线，后者指某一价格下的具体数量。
nEn: The Demand Curve and Why It Moves
xEn: A price change moves you along the curve; income, tastes or substitute prices shift the whole curve. Demand & supply Movement along Only the good's own price changes quantity demanded, holding everything else constant. Shift right Higher income, shifting tastes, pricier substitutes or more buyers all raise demand. Shift left Pricier complements, expectations of future discounts or cheaper substitutes reduce demand. Demand vs quantity Demand is the whole curve; quantity demanded is the amount at a given price.

x: 涨价能否增加收入，取决于需求弹性；弹性小于 1 时涨价增收，大于 1 时涨价反而减收。 需求供给 缺乏弹性 必需品、替代品少、占支出比例小 → 涨价后销量跌得少，收入增加。 富有弹性 非必需、替代品多、比价方便 → 涨价后销量大跌，收入可能下降。 长期更敏感 短期难以改变习惯，长期可以换车、搬家、改配方，弹性上升。 定价启示 把不同弹性的人群分开（学生票、早鸟价），是提高总收入的标准做法。
xEn: Whether a price rise raises revenue depends on elasticity: below 1 it helps, above 1 it hurts. Demand & supply Inelastic Necessities with few substitutes and a small budget share lose few sales, so revenue rises. Elastic Discretionary goods with many substitutes lose sales sharply, so revenue can fall. More elastic over time Habits adjust slowly: over time people can switch cars or suppliers, raising elasticity. Pricing lesson Separating groups by elasticity — student fares, early-bird rates — is the standard way to raise revenue.

x: 固定成本、可变成本与边际成本决定企业的盈亏平衡点与最优产量。 企业 固定成本 与产量无关（厂房、软件研发、牌照），产量越大单件摊得越薄。 可变成本 随产量变化（原料、计件工资、运费）。 边际成本 多做一件的增量成本；只要价格高于它，短期内继续生产就是合理的。 盈亏平衡 总贡献（价格 − 可变成本）覆盖固定成本时的产量即为平衡点。
xEn: Fixed, variable and marginal costs determine a firm's break-even point and optimal output. The firm Fixed Independent of output (plants, software development, licences) and spread thinner as volume grows. Variable Scales with output: materials, piece-rate wages, freight. Marginal The extra cost of one more unit: while price exceeds it, producing on is rational in the short run. Break-even The output at which total contribution (price minus variable cost) covers fixed cost.

x: 从完全竞争到垄断，卖家数量与产品差异决定定价权，也决定对消费者与效率的影响。 市场结构 完全竞争 众多小卖家、同质产品、自由进出，长期利润趋近于零。 垄断竞争 产品有差异（餐馆、服装），短期有定价权，长期因进入而摊薄。 寡头 少数几家彼此牵制，策略互动明显，可能默契维持高价。 垄断 单一卖家可定价，但受需求约束；若靠壁垒维持，需监管介入。
xEn: From perfect competition to monopoly, seller count and differentiation determine pricing power and welfare. Market structure Perfect competition Many small sellers of identical goods with free entry: long-run profit tends to zero. Monopolistic competition Differentiated products (restaurants, apparel) give short-run pricing power that erodes with entry. Oligopoly A few interdependent players: strategic interaction can sustain high prices tacitly. Monopoly A single seller can set price, limited by demand; if sustained by barriers, regulation follows.

x: 庇古税、排污权交易、科斯式产权界定与直接管制各有适用条件与代价。 市场失灵 庇古税 按边际外部成本征税，把社会成本内化到价格中，简单但税率难定。 排污权交易 先定总量再让市场分配配额，减排成本低者多减、成本高者购买。 产权界定 若交易成本低、产权清晰，双方可自行协商达成有效结果（科斯定理）。 直接管制 标准、禁令、技术强制，执行确定但往往缺乏灵活性、成本更高。
xEn: Pigouvian taxes, permit trading, Coasean property rights and direct regulation each fit different conditions. Market failure Pigouvian tax Taxing the marginal external cost internalises it, yet the right rate is hard to know. Cap and trade Cap the total and let the market allocate permits: cheap abaters cut more, costly ones buy. Property rights With clear rights and low transaction costs, parties can bargain to an efficient outcome (Coase). Regulation Standards, bans and technology mandates are certain to enforce but inflexible and often costlier.

x: 一方知道得更多，市场可能萎缩甚至消失，因为好商品被坏商品挤出。 市场失灵 逆向选择 交易前信息劣势方无法分辨质量，只愿出平均价，优质卖家退出。 道德风险 交易后因有人兜底而改变行为，如参保后更不注意健康。 信号 有成本且难以伪造的信号（学历、认证、保修）能重建信任。 筛选 信息劣势方设计机制让不同类型自我暴露，如免赔额与自付比例。
xEn: When one side knows more, markets can shrink or vanish as good products are driven out. Market failure Adverse selection Before contracting, the less informed side pays an average price, so high-quality sellers exit. Moral hazard After contracting, protection changes behaviour, such as taking fewer health precautions once insured. Signalling Costly, hard-to-fake signals (degrees, certification, warranties) rebuild trust. Screening The less informed side designs menus that make types reveal themselves, such as deductibles.

x: 从实物、金属、可兑换纸币到信用货币，每一次切换都源于信任载体的变化。 货币 实物与金属 贝壳、盐、白银、黄金因稀缺与易分割而被选为货币。 可兑换纸币 钱庄与银行发行的票据，承诺可换金属，降低了携带成本。 金本位与崩溃 固定兑换限制了政策空间，大萧条与战争迫使各国相继脱钩。 信用货币 价值来自国家信用与法定清偿地位，货币政策获得更大空间，也承担更大责任。
xEn: From commodities to metal, convertible notes and fiat money, each switch followed a change in what carries trust. Money Commodity and metal Shells, salt, silver and gold were chosen for scarcity and divisibility. Convertible notes Bank notes promising metal on demand cut the cost of carrying value. Gold standard and its end Fixed convertibility limited policy space; depression and war pushed countries off it. Fiat money Value rests on state credibility and legal tender status: more policy room, and more responsibility.

x: 政策利率、公开市场操作、准备金要求与资产购买，是调节货币条件的主要工具。 央行 政策利率 最常用的信号工具，直接改变短端资金价格。 公开市场操作 买卖证券调节银行体系流动性，让市场利率贴近目标。 准备金与宏观审慎 准备金率、资本缓冲、贷款价值比等工具直接约束信贷扩张。 资产购买与前瞻指引 利率触底后压降长端利率，并用沟通管理预期。
xEn: Policy rates, open market operations, reserve requirements and asset purchases are the main levers. Central bank Policy rate The most used signal, directly moving the price of short-term funds. Open market operations Buying and selling securities to keep market rates near target. Reserves and macroprudential Reserve ratios, capital buffers and loan-to-value caps directly constrain credit growth. Asset purchases and guidance With rates at the floor, buying assets pushes long yields down while communication steers expectations.

x: 从政策利率到货币市场利率、国债收益率、信贷利率，构成一条层层加价的传导链。 利率 无风险利率 通常以国债收益率为基准，是其他资产定价的锚。 期限溢价 期限越长不确定性越大，投资者要求额外补偿，形成上倾曲线。 信用溢价 违约风险越高，借款利率相对无风险利率的加点越大。 期限错配 短借长贷是银行盈利模式，也是流动性风险的根源。
xEn: From the policy rate to money-market rates, government yields and lending rates, rates form a chain of mark-ups. Rates Risk-free rate Usually the government yield, the anchor for pricing other assets. Term premium Longer maturities carry more uncertainty, so investors demand extra compensation, sloping the curve up. Credit spread Higher default risk means a larger spread over the risk-free rate. Maturity mismatch Borrowing short and lending long is the banking business model and the root of liquidity risk.

x: 银行不是把存款贷出去，而是「先放贷、后创存款」，货币因此内生扩张。 银行 贷款创造存款 发放贷款时同时在借款人账户记账，货币总量随即增加。 准备金约束 准备金与资本充足率限制扩张上限，但通常不是日常最紧的约束。 货币乘数 教科书以准备金率倒推乘数，现实中受信贷需求与银行风险偏好影响。 影子银行 非银机构承担信用中介功能，扩张了货币与信用，也带来监管盲区。
xEn: Banks do not lend out deposits; they lend first and create the deposit, so money expands endogenously. Banking Loans create deposits Making a loan simultaneously credits the borrower's account, so the money stock rises. Reserve constraint Reserves and capital ratios cap expansion but are rarely the binding constraint day to day. Money multiplier Textbooks derive a multiplier from reserve ratios; in practice credit demand and bank risk appetite dominate. Shadow banking Non-bank intermediaries extend credit and money, expanding both and creating regulatory blind spots.

x: 固定、浮动与有管理的浮动各有利弊，核心权衡是「稳定」与「政策自主」不可兼得。 汇率 固定汇率 锚定他国货币，降低贸易与投资不确定性，但需消耗外储并让渡货币政策。 浮动汇率 由市场决定，货币政策独立，但汇率波动增加企业风险管理成本。 有管理浮动 以市场为主、必要时干预，实践中大多数经济体处于这一区间。 不可能三角 资本自由流动、固定汇率、独立货币政策，三者最多同时实现两个。
xEn: Fixed, floating and managed floats trade off stability against policy autonomy. Foreign exchange Fixed Pegging to another currency reduces trade uncertainty but costs reserves and monetary autonomy. Floating Market-determined rates preserve policy independence but raise hedging costs for firms. Managed float Mostly market-driven with occasional intervention: where most economies actually sit. Impossible trinity Free capital flows, a fixed rate and independent policy: at most two of the three.

x: 泡沫的典型配方是宽松资金 + 新叙事 + 杠杆 + 错配，破裂则通过资产负债表传染。 金融稳定 形成条件 低利率、金融创新、新叙事（新技术/新市场）与羊群行为共同推高价格。 传染路径 资产价格下跌触发追缴保证金与抛售，抵押品价值下降压缩信贷。 政策应对 降息、流动性支持、担保与资本注入，优先阻断系统性传染。 事后代价 去杠杆导致长期低增长与失业上升，恢复往往以年计。
xEn: Bubbles typically combine easy money, a new story, leverage and mismatch; the crash spreads through balance sheets. Financial stability Conditions Low rates, financial innovation, a new story and herding push prices up together. Contagion Falling prices trigger margin calls and selling; collateral values drop and credit contracts. Policy response Rate cuts, liquidity support, guarantees and recapitalisation aim to stop systemic contagion. Aftermath Deleveraging brings prolonged weak growth and higher unemployment; recovery takes years.

x: 论证了自利行为在分工与市场机制下可以带来公共福利。 古典经济学 苏格兰 1723–1790 斯密把经济学从道德哲学的附庸变成独立学科。《国富论》系统论述了分工、市场范围、价格机制与自由贸易，并用「看不见的手」说明个体逐利与整体秩序之间的关系。他也强调制度、司法与教育是市场运转的前提。 分工提高生产率 分工受市场范围限制，专业化程度越高，单位产出效率越高。 看不见的手 价格信号协调分散决策，无需中央指挥即可实现资源配置。 自由贸易 反对重商主义的零和观，主张各国按自身优势参与交换。 制度前提 法治、产权与教育是市场有效运作的必要条件，而非自然存在。
xEn: Showed how self-interest, under division of labour and markets, can produce public benefit. Classical Scotland 1723–1790 Smith turned economics into a discipline of its own. The Wealth of Nations set out division of labour, the extent of markets, price formation and free trade, and used the 'invisible hand' to link private pursuit with public order. He also stressed that institutions, justice and education underpin markets. Division of labour Specialisation raises output per worker, and is limited by the extent of the market. Invisible hand Price signals coordinate dispersed decisions without central direction. Free trade A critique of mercantilist zero-sum thinking: nations gain by trading on their strengths. Institutional preconditions Rule of law, property rights and education are necessary conditions for markets, not natural givens.

x: 用比较优势与地租理论把经济学推向更严密的推理。 古典经济学 英国 1772–1823 李嘉图是证券交易员出身的理论家，擅长用抽象模型抓住核心机制。他提出的比较优势至今是国际贸易理论的基石，地租理论则解释了为何技术进步的好处可能被土地所有者吸收。他还讨论了税收归宿与公债负担。 比较优势 按相对机会成本分工，即便一方全面落后，双方仍可从贸易中获益。 级差地租 地租来自土地肥力差异，随粮价上升而上涨，可能吞掉利润。 税收归宿 名义纳税人未必是实际负担者，负担取决于供需弹性。 等价定理雏形 政府用征税还是借债融资，长期看对居民负担可能并无本质差别。
xEn: Pushed economics towards rigorous reasoning with comparative advantage and rent theory. Classical United Kingdom 1772–1823 A stockbroker turned theorist, Ricardo excelled at abstract models that isolate mechanisms. His comparative advantage remains the cornerstone of trade theory, while his rent theory explains how landlords can absorb the gains from technical progress. He also analysed tax incidence and public debt burdens. Comparative advantage Specialise by relative opportunity cost: both sides gain even if one is worse at everything. Differential rent Rent arises from fertility differences and rises with grain prices, potentially squeezing profit. Tax incidence The legal taxpayer is not always the real bearer; elasticity decides. Debt vs tax Financing spending by tax or by debt may not differ fundamentally in the long run.

x: 从资本积累与阶级关系出发，分析资本主义的内在矛盾与危机倾向。 古典政治经济学批判 德国 1818–1883 马克思继承并批判古典经济学，把生产关系的所有权结构放在分析中心。《资本论》讨论了价值、剩余价值、资本有机构成与利润率下降趋势，并预言周期性危机。其分析方法对经济史、制度经济学与不平等研究都有持续影响。 剩余价值 工人创造的价值超过其工资部分，差额构成资本积累来源。 资本积累 竞争迫使资本不断再投资，生产能力扩张与消费能力不足并存。 周期性危机 生产社会化与占有私人化之间的矛盾导致周期性过剩危机。 利润率下降 资本有机构成提高被认为会压低长期利润率，引发争议至今。
xEn: Analysed capitalism's internal contradictions and crisis tendencies through accumulation and class relations. Critique of classical political economy Germany 1818–1883 Marx inherited and criticised classical economics, placing ownership of the relations of production at the centre. Capital examined value, surplus value, the organic composition of capital and falling profit rates, and foresaw cyclical crises. His analytical approach still informs economic history, institutional economics and inequality research. Surplus value Workers create value beyond their wage, and the difference funds capital accumulation. Accumulation Competition forces continual reinvestment, so capacity expands while consumption lags. Crisis tendency Socialised production versus private appropriation produces recurring crises of overproduction. Falling profit rate A rising organic composition of capital is argued to depress long-run profit rates — still debated.

x: 把供需曲线、弹性与边际分析整合成现代微观经济学的基本框架。 新古典经济学 英国 1842–1924 马歇尔是微观经济学的奠基者，他用「剪刀」比喻供给与需求共同决定价格，提出弹性、消费者剩余、短期与长期区分等概念与工具，使经济学从文字论述转向可计算的分析。他也关注贫困与教育问题。 供需共同定价 价格既不单由成本决定也不单由效用决定，而由两者共同决定。 弹性 用数量对价格的敏感度衡量市场反应，成为政策分析的常用工具。 短期与长期 短期产能固定、长期可调整，同一冲击在两个时间尺度上结果不同。 消费者剩余 愿意支付与实际支付之差，为评估政策福利提供量化基础。
xEn: Integrated supply, demand, elasticity and marginal analysis into modern microeconomics. Neoclassical United Kingdom 1842–1924 Marshall founded modern microeconomics. His scissors analogy showed supply and demand determining price jointly, and he introduced elasticity, consumer surplus and the short-run versus long-run distinction, moving economics from prose to computable analysis. He also cared about poverty and education. Both blades cut Price is set neither by cost alone nor utility alone, but by both together. Elasticity Measuring quantity response to price became a standard policy tool. Short vs long run Capacity is fixed in the short run and adjustable in the long run, so shocks play out differently. Consumer surplus Willingness to pay minus actual payment, a quantitative basis for welfare evaluation.

x: 论证总需求不足会导致长期失业，政府应主动出手稳定经济。 凯恩斯主义 英国 1883–1946 面对大萧条，凯恩斯指出经济不会自动回到充分就业，因为工资与价格调整缓慢、预期不稳定。他主张以财政与货币政策补足需求，并参与设计战后布雷顿森林体系。他的框架奠定了现代宏观经济学与反周期调控的基础。 有效需求 产出与就业由总需求决定，需求不足时均衡可以停留在高失业状态。 动物精神 投资取决于信心与预期，而非纯粹的理性计算，因此波动难以避免。 乘数效应 政府支出转化为收入再被消费，总效果大于初始支出。 逆周期调节 繁荣时收紧、衰退时扩张，以平抑波动而非追求年度平衡。
xEn: Argued that insufficient aggregate demand causes persistent unemployment, so government must act. Keynesian United Kingdom 1883–1946 Facing the Great Depression, Keynes argued economies do not automatically return to full employment because wages and prices adjust slowly and expectations are unstable. He advocated fiscal and monetary action to fill the demand gap and helped design the Bretton Woods system, laying the foundation for modern macroeconomics and countercyclical policy. Effective demand Output and employment are demand-determined, so equilibrium can settle at high unemployment. Animal spirits Investment depends on confidence and expectations, not pure calculation, so swings are unavoidable. Multiplier Government spending becomes income that is spent again, so the total exceeds the initial outlay. Countercyclical policy Tighten in booms and ease in downturns to smooth cycles rather than balance annually.

x: 强调知识分散与价格信号的作用，警惕中央计划的信息难题。 奥地利学派 奥地利 / 英国 1899–1992 哈耶克的核心洞见是：经济运行所需的知识分散在无数个体手中，无法集中。价格是压缩并传递这些信息的机制。因此他反对全面计划，也批评过度刺激扭曲利率信号、引发资源错配。他与凯恩斯关于需求管理的争论延续至今。 知识问题 关键知识是局部、隐性的，中央计划者无法完整获取。 价格即信号 价格以极低成本传递稀缺信息，协调陌生人的行动。 自发秩序 复杂秩序可以自下而上形成，不必由谁设计。 货币政策批评 长期低利率会误导资本投向，最终以危机方式清算。
xEn: Emphasised dispersed knowledge and price signals, warning of the information problem in central planning. Austrian Austria / UK 1899–1992 Hayek's central insight: the knowledge needed to run an economy is dispersed across millions and cannot be centralised. Prices compress and transmit that knowledge. Hence his opposition to comprehensive planning and his criticism that excessive stimulus distorts interest-rate signals and misallocates resources. His debate with Keynes over demand management continues. Knowledge problem Crucial knowledge is local and tacit, beyond any planner's reach. Prices as signals Prices transmit scarcity information at very low cost, coordinating strangers. Spontaneous order Complex order can emerge bottom-up without being designed. Monetary critique Prolonged low rates misdirect capital, eventually corrected through crisis.

x: 把企业家创新与「创造性破坏」视为资本主义增长的核心动力。 创新与演化经济学 奥地利 / 美国 1883–1950 熊彼特认为静态均衡不是重点，真正的主题是技术与组织创新如何打破旧结构。企业家是引入新组合的人，创新会带来垄断利润，也会被下一轮创新摧毁——这就是「创造性破坏」。他的思想是创新政策、产业演化与反垄断讨论的重要来源。 创造性破坏 增长来自新旧结构的持续替换，而非静态效率改进。 企业家与创新 创新是「新组合」的落地：新产品、新工艺、新市场、新组织。 暂时垄断 创新者获得的超额利润是激励，也是下一轮竞争的目标。 信贷与创新 银行信贷为创新提供购买力，是创新得以实现的必要条件。
xEn: Placed entrepreneurial innovation and creative destruction at the core of capitalist growth. Innovation and evolutionary economics Austria / USA 1883–1950 For Schumpeter static equilibrium was beside the point: the real subject was how technological and organisational innovation breaks old structures. Entrepreneurs introduce new combinations; innovation yields monopoly profits and is then destroyed by the next wave — creative destruction. His ideas underpin innovation policy, industry evolution and antitrust debates. Creative destruction Growth comes from continuously replacing old structures, not static efficiency gains. Entrepreneur Innovation is implementing new combinations: products, processes, markets, organisation. Temporary monopoly Innovators' excess profits are the incentive and the next round's target. Credit Bank credit supplies the purchasing power that makes innovation possible.

x: 主张「通胀在任何时候任何地方都是货币现象」，并强调规则优于相机抉择。 货币主义 / 芝加哥学派 美国 1912–2006 弗里德曼重建了货币数量论，认为长期通胀由货币增速决定，财政刺激无法持续提高产出。他对大萧条的解释（货币政策失误）改变了学界与央行的认知，也推动了通胀目标制与央行独立性。他还以《资本主义与自由》影响公共政策辩论。 货币数量论 长期看货币增速决定物价水平，产出由实体因素决定。 自然失业率 扩张政策无法长期压低失业率，只会推高通胀。 规则而非相机 可预期的固定规则比频繁干预更能稳定预期。 永久收入假说 消费取决于长期收入预期，一次性补贴多半被存起来。
xEn: Argued that inflation is always and everywhere a monetary phenomenon, favouring rules over discretion. Monetarism / Chicago USA 1912–2006 Friedman revived the quantity theory, arguing that long-run inflation is set by money growth and that fiscal stimulus cannot raise output permanently. His reinterpretation of the Great Depression as a monetary policy failure reshaped academia and central banking and helped bring inflation targeting and central bank independence. Capitalism and Freedom shaped public policy debates. Quantity theory In the long run money growth determines prices while real factors determine output. Natural rate Expansion cannot hold unemployment below its natural rate without accelerating inflation. Rules over discretion Predictable rules stabilise expectations better than frequent discretionary actions. Permanent income Consumption tracks expected long-run income, so one-off transfers are largely saved.

x: 市场能自我调节，增长来自分工、资本积累与自由贸易，政府应少干预。 1776–1870 年代 亚当·斯密 大卫·李嘉图 托马斯·马尔萨斯 约翰·穆勒 劳动价值论：价值源于劳动投入 比较优势与自由贸易互利 萨伊定律：供给自动创造需求 人口与土地报酬递减的长期悲观 首次系统解释价格机制与分工，为现代经济学奠定语言与问题清单。 低估了需求不足与失业的持续性；劳动价值论难以解释价格结构；对市场自我修复过于乐观。
xEn: Markets self-adjust; growth comes from division of labour, capital accumulation and free trade, so government should do little. 1776–1870s Adam Smith David Ricardo Thomas Malthus John Stuart Mill Labour theory of value: value derives from labour input Comparative advantage makes trade mutually beneficial Say's law: supply creates its own demand Long-run pessimism from population growth and diminishing returns First systematic account of price mechanisms and division of labour, setting modern economics' language and agenda. Underestimated persistent demand deficiency and unemployment; the labour theory of value struggles with relative prices; too optimistic about self-correction.

x: 价格由供需共同决定，个体在约束下追求效用最大化，边际分析成为通用工具。 1870 年代–1930 年代 阿尔弗雷德·马歇尔 莱昂·瓦尔拉斯 威廉·杰文斯 维尔弗雷多·帕累托 边际效用递减决定需求 一般均衡：所有市场同时出清 弹性与消费者剩余等量化工具 帕累托效率作为福利评价标准 把经济学变成可推理、可计算的分析体系，解释力与操作性大幅提升。 假设完全信息与理性过于理想；对总量与失业问题缺乏解释，为大萧条所冲击。
xEn: Price comes from supply and demand together; individuals maximise utility under constraints, and marginal analysis becomes the general tool. 1870s–1930s Alfred Marshall Léon Walras William Jevons Vilfredo Pareto Diminishing marginal utility drives demand General equilibrium: all markets clear simultaneously Quantitative tools such as elasticity and consumer surplus Pareto efficiency as the welfare benchmark Turned economics into a deductive, computable system with far greater explanatory and operational power. Assumes perfect information and rationality; says little about aggregate demand and unemployment, which the Depression exposed.

x: 总需求不足会造成持续失业，政府应主动用财政与货币政策补足需求。 1936–1970 年代（后经新凯恩斯主义复兴） 约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯 保罗·萨缪尔森 詹姆斯·托宾 约翰·希克斯 有效需求决定产出与就业 工资与价格粘性使市场调整缓慢 乘数效应放大财政支出效果 逆周期调控可平滑波动 成功解释了大萧条并指导战后二十年的高速增长与低失业。 1970 年代滞胀暴露其通胀盲点；长期赤字与债务可持续性受质疑；政策时滞与政治周期问题突出。
xEn: Insufficient aggregate demand causes persistent unemployment, so government should fill the gap with fiscal and monetary policy. 1936–1970s, later revived as New Keynesian John Maynard Keynes Paul Samuelson James Tobin John Hicks Effective demand determines output and employment Sticky wages and prices slow adjustment The multiplier amplifies fiscal spending Countercyclical policy can smooth cycles Explained the Great Depression and guided two decades of fast growth with low unemployment after 1945. The 1970s stagflation exposed its inflation blind spot; long-run deficit sustainability is questioned; policy lags and political cycles are problematic.

x: 长期通胀由货币增速决定，政策应以稳定货币增长的可预期规则为纲。 1956 年至今 米尔顿·弗里德曼 安娜·施瓦茨 卡尔·布伦纳 艾伦·梅尔策 通胀本质是货币现象 自然失业率：扩张无法长期降低失业 规则优于相机抉择 货币政策存在长而多变的时滞 对 1970 年代通胀给出有效诊断，推动通胀目标制与央行独立性成为主流制度。 货币需求并不稳定，狭义货币增速与通胀的关系在金融创新后弱化；对 2008 年后的非常规政策指导有限。
xEn: Long-run inflation is set by money growth, so policy should follow predictable rules for stable money growth. 1956–present Milton Friedman Anna Schwartz Karl Brunner Allan Meltzer Inflation is fundamentally a monetary phenomenon The natural rate: expansion cannot lower unemployment permanently Rules beat discretion Monetary policy works with long and variable lags Diagnosed 1970s inflation effectively and helped make inflation targeting and central bank independence mainstream. Money demand is unstable, and the link between narrow money growth and inflation weakened with financial innovation; limited guidance for post-2008 unconventional policy.

x: 经济是分散知识下的动态过程，价格信号与企业家发现是核心，反对过度干预。 1871 年至今 卡尔·门格尔 欧根·冯·米塞斯 弗里德里希·哈耶克 伊斯雷尔·柯兹纳 主观价值论：价值源于个体评价 知识与价格信号问题 资本结构与利率扭曲导致错配 企业家发现驱动市场过程 对知识分散、制度约束与货币扭曲的分析深刻，影响了转型经济与制度经济学。 对市场自发调整过于乐观；缺乏可检验的宏观预测；低估了危机中流动性支持的必要性。
xEn: The economy is a dynamic process under dispersed knowledge; price signals and entrepreneurial discovery are central, so intervention should be limited. 1871–present Carl Menger Ludwig von Mises Friedrich Hayek Israel Kirzner Subjective value: value reflects individual valuation The knowledge and price-signal problem Capital structure and rate distortions cause misallocation Entrepreneurial discovery drives the market process Deep analysis of dispersed knowledge, institutional constraints and monetary distortion influenced transition economies and institutional economics. Overly optimistic about self-correction; offers few testable macro predictions; understates the need for liquidity support in crises.

x: 制度安排与真实心理过程决定经济结果；交易成本与认知偏差都不可忽略。 1937 年至今 罗纳德·科斯 道格拉斯·诺斯 埃莉诺·奥斯特罗姆 丹尼尔·卡尼曼 理查德·塞勒 交易成本决定企业与市场的边界 产权与制度质量影响长期增长 公共池塘资源可由社区规则有效治理 前景理论：损失厌恶与参照点依赖 把制度与现实人性纳入分析，解释了大量标准模型无法解释的现象，政策可操作性更强。 理论整合度低于主流框架；行为干预的长期效果与规模适用性仍存争议。
xEn: Institutions and real psychological processes determine outcomes; neither transaction costs nor cognitive bias can be ignored. 1937–present Ronald Coase Douglass North Elinor Ostrom Daniel Kahneman Richard Thaler Transaction costs set the boundary between firm and market Property rights and institutional quality shape long-run growth Common-pool resources can be governed by community rules Prospect theory: loss aversion and reference dependence Brings institutions and real human behaviour into analysis, explaining much that standard models cannot and making policy more workable. Less unified than mainstream frameworks; the long-run effect and scalability of behavioural interventions remain contested.

x: 1602 荷兰 世界上第一家公开发行股票、可自由转让股份的跨国股份公司成立。 远洋贸易风险巨大、需要长期巨额资本，合伙制无法承担，于是出现了有限责任与股份转让机制。 催生了阿姆斯特丹证券交易所与近代资本市场，也为公司治理、审计与信息披露制度埋下伏笔。
nEn: Founding of the Dutch East India Company
xEn: 1602 Netherlands The first multinational joint-stock company to issue publicly tradable shares was founded. Long-distance trade was risky and capital-hungry beyond partnership capacity, so limited liability and share transfer emerged. It spawned the Amsterdam stock exchange and modern capital markets, planting the seeds of corporate governance, audit and disclosure.

x: 1776 英国 亚当·斯密系统论述分工、市场机制与自由贸易，经济学第一次成为独立学科。 工业革命前夕，重商主义管制盛行，需要一套解释财富来源的新框架。 确立了「市场协调分散决策」的核心命题，直接影响此后两百多年的经济政策与贸易秩序。
nEn: The Wealth of Nations Is Published
xEn: 1776 United Kingdom Adam Smith set out division of labour, market mechanisms and free trade, founding economics as a discipline. On the eve of industrialisation, mercantilist controls prevailed and a new framework for the sources of wealth was needed. Established the core proposition that markets coordinate dispersed decisions, shaping economic policy and trade for two centuries.

x: 1825 英国 投机性投资与信贷扩张后急剧收缩，多家银行倒闭，失业与破产同时上升。 新兴的银行体系与股票市场第一次把信贷、投资与情绪连成放大回路。 证明危机是工业化金融体系的常态特征，推动了公司法、银行监管与最后贷款人角色的讨论。
xEn: 1825 United Kingdom Speculative investment and credit expansion collapsed abruptly, banks failed and unemployment and bankruptcies rose together. For the first time the new banking system and stock market linked credit, investment and sentiment into an amplifying loop. Proved crises are a regular feature of industrial financial systems, prompting debate on company law, bank regulation and a lender of last resort.

x: 1870 年代 欧洲与北美 主要经济体把本币与黄金固定挂钩，形成事实上的固定汇率体系。 贸易与投资扩张需要稳定的汇兑环境，而黄金被视为超越国家信用的锚。 促进了国际贸易与资本流动，但也限制了逆周期调控空间，最终在大萧条与战争冲击下瓦解。
nEn: The Classical Gold Standard Takes Shape
xEn: 1870s Europe and North America Major economies pegged their currencies to gold, creating a de facto fixed-rate system. Expanding trade and investment needed exchange-rate stability, and gold was seen as an anchor beyond state credit. It boosted trade and capital flows while restricting countercyclical policy, and it fell apart under depression and war.

x: 1929 美国 → 全球 股市崩盘后信贷收缩、银行连锁倒闭，全球产出与物价深度下滑，失业率飙升。 货币紧缩、金本位约束、银行挤兑与贸易保护主义相互强化，政策失误放大了冲击。 催生了凯恩斯革命、存款保险、证券监管与布雷顿森林体系，重塑了此后八十年的宏观政策框架。
xEn: 1929 United States → global After the crash, credit contracted and banks failed in chains; global output and prices fell deeply and unemployment soared. Monetary tightening, the gold standard, bank runs and protectionism reinforced each other, and policy errors amplified the shock. It produced the Keynesian revolution, deposit insurance, securities regulation and Bretton Woods, reshaping macro policy for eighty years.

x: 1936 英国 凯恩斯提出总需求不足会导致持续失业，宏观经济学由此诞生。 古典理论无法解释大萧条后的长期高失业，需要一套以总量需求为核心的新框架。 战后三十年财政与货币政策成为调控常态，并演化为今天的新凯恩斯主义模型。
xEn: 1936 United Kingdom Keynes argued insufficient aggregate demand causes persistent unemployment, and macroeconomics was born. Classical theory could not explain persistent mass unemployment, so a framework centred on aggregate demand was needed. For three decades fiscal and monetary policy became routine tools, evolving into today's New Keynesian models.

x: 1944 美国 新罕布什尔 美元与黄金挂钩、其他货币与美元挂钩的固定汇率体系建立，并成立 IMF 与世界银行。 战后重建需要稳定汇率与融资渠道，同时要避免重蹈 1930 年代竞争性贬值的覆辙。 带来近三十年的贸易扩张与相对稳定，同时确立了以 IMF 为核心的国际货币协调机制。
nEn: The Bretton Woods System Is Established
xEn: 1944 New Hampshire, USA A fixed-rate system pegged the dollar to gold and other currencies to the dollar, with the IMF and World Bank created. Reconstruction needed stable rates and financing while avoiding a repeat of 1930s competitive devaluation. It delivered nearly three decades of trade expansion and relative stability and established IMF-centred monetary coordination.

n: 尼克松冲击：美元与黄金脱钩
x: 1971 美国 美国单方面停止美元兑换黄金，布雷顿森林体系固定汇率基础崩塌。 长期财政赤字与海外美元债务使黄金储备不足以支撑承诺兑换。 世界进入信用货币与浮动汇率时代，货币政策获得更大空间，也带来更高的通胀风险。
nEn: The Nixon Shock: the Dollar Leaves Gold
xEn: 1971 United States The United States suspended dollar convertibility into gold, destroying the fixed-rate basis of Bretton Woods. Persistent deficits and overseas dollar liabilities left gold reserves unable to honour convertibility. The world entered the fiat-money and floating-rate era: more monetary room and higher inflation risk.

x: 1973 中东 → 全球 石油禁运与价格暴涨数倍，工业国同时出现高通胀与经济停滞。 地缘冲突触发供给中断，而需求短期缺乏弹性，涨价压力迅速传导到全产业链。 「滞胀」成为现实，凯恩斯式需求管理失效，理论与政策转向货币主义与供给侧。
xEn: 1973 Middle East → global An oil embargo and a multi-fold price rise hit industrial economies with inflation and stagnation at once. Geopolitical conflict cut supply while demand was inelastic in the short run, transmitting price pressure across supply chains. 'Stagflation' became real, Keynesian demand management failed and thinking turned to monetarism and supply-side policy.

x: 1979–1982 美国 美联储把政策利率提高到 20% 上下的历史高位，以两年深度衰退换取通胀回落。 通胀预期已经根深蒂固，只有足够强烈的紧缩才能重建央行可信度。 通胀预期被锚定，奠定了此后四十年央行独立性与通胀目标制的制度共识。
xEn: 1979–1982 United States The Federal Reserve raised policy rates towards 20%, accepting a deep two-year recession to break inflation. Inflation expectations had become entrenched, so only decisively severe tightening could rebuild credibility. Expectations were anchored, establishing a forty-year consensus on central bank independence and inflation targeting.

x: 1985 美国 纽约 五国联合干预外汇市场，推动美元对日元与马克大幅贬值。 美国贸易逆差与保护主义压力上升，希望通过汇率调整而非关税解决失衡。 日元快速升值长期影响日本产业与资产价格，成为讨论汇率协调与资产泡沫的经典案例。
xEn: 1985 New York, USA Five countries jointly intervened in currency markets, driving a sharp depreciation of the dollar against the yen and mark. With a widening US trade deficit and rising protectionism, exchange-rate adjustment was preferred to tariffs. The yen's rapid appreciation shaped Japanese industry and asset prices, making it a classic case in exchange-rate coordination and bubbles.

x: 1997 东南亚 → 东亚 货币与资产价格暴跌，短期外债无法续借，多国被迫求助国际救助并陷入深度衰退。 固定汇率、大量短期外币借款与本币资产之间的期限和货币错配，一旦资本外流便迅速崩溃。 亚洲多国转向浮动汇率与外汇储备积累，IMF 的救助条件也引发广泛争论与改革。
xEn: 1997 Southeast Asia → East Asia Currencies and asset prices collapsed, short-term foreign debt could not be rolled over and countries sought international rescue. Pegged rates, large short-term foreign borrowing and local-currency assets created currency and maturity mismatch that unravelled on outflows. Many Asian economies moved to floating rates and reserve accumulation, and IMF conditionality came under intense debate and reform.

x: 2008 美国 → 全球 次贷违约引发抵押证券暴跌，大型金融机构倒闭或被救助，全球信贷市场冻结。 高杠杆、复杂证券化、期限错配与监管盲区叠加，把局部房贷风险放大为系统风险。 催生宏观审慎监管、压力测试与《巴塞尔协议 III》，并开启长达十余年的低利率与量化宽松时代。
xEn: 2008 United States → global Subprime defaults crashed mortgage securities, major institutions failed or were rescued, and global credit markets froze. High leverage, complex securitisation, maturity mismatch and regulatory blind spots amplified local mortgage risk into systemic risk. It produced macroprudential regulation, stress testing and Basel III, and opened a decade-long era of low rates and quantitative easing.

x: 2020 全球 供给与需求同时停摆，各国推出史无前例的财政转移与资产购买计划。 封控直接切断供给，收入骤降又冲击需求，需要「直达居民」的财政手段以避免资产负债表崩塌。 避免了债务通缩式萧条，但也带来后续通胀压力、财政债务上升与央行资产负债表大幅扩张。
nEn: The Pandemic Shock and Unprecedented Easing
xEn: 2020 Global Supply and demand halted together, and governments launched unprecedented fiscal transfers and asset purchases. Lockdowns cut supply while income collapse hit demand, requiring direct-to-household fiscal support to prevent balance-sheet collapse. It avoided a debt-deflationary slump but left higher inflation, larger public debt and greatly expanded central bank balance sheets.

x: 2022–2024 全球 多国通胀升至数十年高位，主要央行以历史级速度加息，资产估值与房地产明显承压。 供给冲击、需求结构变化与劳动力紧张叠加，使通胀从局部品类扩散为核心通胀。 再度验证央行可信度与通胀预期管理的重要性，也让「滞胀风险」重新回到政策讨论中心。
nEn: The Global Inflation Surge and Rapid Hiking
xEn: 2022–2024 Global Inflation hit multi-decade highs in many countries and major central banks hiked at historic speed, pressuring valuations and housing. Supply shocks, shifted demand composition and tight labour markets spread inflation from individual categories into core measures. It re-confirmed the importance of credibility and expectation management and returned stagflation risk to policy debate.

x: 人对得失的判断基于参照点，且对损失比对收益敏感得多。 核心理论 卡尼曼与特沃斯基发现，人们在收益区域倾向风险规避，在损失区域反而倾向冒险。价值函数以参照点为界呈 S 形，损失一侧更陡，收益一侧逐渐变平。这解释了为什么「先涨后跌」比「一直平稳」更让人难受。 抛硬币赌局中，实验对象普遍要求「赢了得 200 元才愿意冒输 100 元的险」，说明损失权重约为收益的 2 倍。 促销说「立减 200」比「打九折」更打动人；因为前者被感知为收益，后者被感知为损失。
xEn: People judge gains and losses relative to a reference point, and losses loom far larger. Core theory Kahneman and Tversky showed people are risk-averse over gains and risk-seeking over losses. The value function is S-shaped around a reference point, steeper for losses and flattening for gains — which explains why a rise followed by a fall feels worse than a flat path. In coin-flip experiments, participants typically demanded a 200 gain to accept a 100 loss, implying roughly double weight on losses. 'Save 200' converts better than '10% off', because one reads as a gain and the other as a smaller loss.

x: 最先接触到的信息会像锚一样，把后续判断拉向它。 判断偏差 即使锚点完全随机、与问题无关，也会显著影响估计值。锚定之所以顽固，是因为人从锚点出发做「不充分的调整」，且倾向于搜寻支持锚点的证据。谈判、定价、估值都深受其影响。 让被试转盘随机转到 10 或 65，再估计联合国中非洲国家占比：转到 10 的平均猜 25%，转到 65 的猜 45%。 商场先标「原价 1299，现价 599」，599 是否划算完全取决于那个被给定的锚。
xEn: The first information encountered drags subsequent judgements towards it. Judgement bias Even random, irrelevant anchors shift estimates materially. Anchoring persists because people adjust insufficiently from the anchor and tend to seek confirming evidence. Negotiations, pricing and valuations are all shaped by it. After a wheel landed on 10 or 65, participants estimated the share of African countries in the UN at about 25% versus 45% respectively. A 'was 1299, now 599' tag makes 599 look cheap purely because of the supplied anchor.

x: 失去 100 元的痛苦，需要赚到远超 100 元才能抵消。 核心理论 损失厌恶是前景理论的核心参数，经验估计损失权重约为收益的 1.5–2.5 倍。它带来一系列可预测后果：不愿止损、过度投保、改革阻力大、以及「所有权带来更高的估值」。 投资者对亏损头寸持有时间显著长于盈利头寸——「处置效应」，因为卖出即承认损失。 订阅自动续费取消按钮做得很深，因为失去已有服务比从未拥有更难接受。
xEn: Losing 100 hurts more than gaining 100 pleases, so gains must exceed losses to compensate. Core theory Loss aversion is the central parameter of prospect theory, empirically around 1.5–2.5 times gains. It produces predictable consequences: reluctance to realise losses, over-insurance, resistance to reform, and higher valuations for what one already owns. Investors hold losing positions notably longer than winners — the disposition effect — because selling makes the loss real. Cancellation flows are deliberately buried: giving up an existing service is harder than never signing up.

x: 跟随多数人行动，哪怕私人信息并不支持。 群体行为 当个体认为他人可能掌握更多信息时，模仿是理性的；但信息级联会把私人信号完全淹没，导致群体集体犯错。金融市场的追涨杀跌、消费潮流的快速形成、以及企业扎堆进入同一赛道都属于此。 阿希线段实验中，即使答案明显错误，只要多数人给出错误答案，约三分之一的被试也会选择从众。 餐厅门口排长队并不代表更好吃，只代表前面有人排队。
xEn: Following the crowd even when private information says otherwise. Group behaviour Imitating others can be rational if they might know more, but information cascades can swamp private signals and produce collective error — as in momentum trading, fast-moving consumer fads and firms piling into the same sector. In Asch's line experiment about a third of participants conformed to a clearly wrong majority answer. A long restaurant queue signals earlier diners, not necessarily better food.

x: 眼前的诱惑被过度放大，导致「今天说好、明天破功」。 时间偏好 标准模型假设贴现率恒定，而实际行为表现为短期贴现率极高、长期迅速下降。这解释了拖延、存不下钱、健身计划半途而废，也说明「承诺机制」（自动储蓄、定期存款、惩罚条款）为何有效。 多数人宁愿今天拿 100 元也不要一年后拿 120 元，却愿意在「一年后」与「一年零一天后」之间选择后者，显示偏好反转。 深夜下单、次日后悔；把购物 App 移出首页或设置 24 小时冷静期就是自我承诺。
xEn: Immediate rewards are over-weighted, producing plans today and broken promises tomorrow. Time preference Standard models assume a constant discount rate, but behaviourally the rate is very high for the near term and drops off quickly. This explains procrastination, undersaving and abandoned fitness plans, and why commitment devices — auto-enrolment, term deposits, penalties — work. Many prefer 100 today over 120 in a year, yet choose 120 in a year and a day over 120 in a year: preference reversal. Late-night purchases regretted next morning; removing shopping apps from the home screen or imposing a 24-hour rule is self-commitment.

x: 同样的钱被分进不同「账户」，彼此不可替代。 判断偏差 人们把收入按来源与用途分类：工资、奖金、彩票、红包各有不同花费规则。结果是同样的 100 元在不同账户中具有不同的边际消费倾向，也让「省下的钱」与「多赚的钱」在心理上不等价。 同一场演出，票是买的还是送的，退票率与再购意愿差异显著，尽管经济价值相同。 年终奖更容易被花掉，而每月工资则被小心规划。
xEn: The same money sits in separate mental accounts that are not interchangeable. Judgement bias People label money by source and purpose — salary, bonus, windfall, gift — and spend each by different rules. As a result, the same 100 has different marginal propensities to consume, and 'saved' money is not psychologically equal to 'earned' money. For the same show, whether a ticket was bought or gifted changes refund behaviour and willingness to rebuy, despite identical value. Year-end bonuses are spent more freely than monthly salary, which tends to be budgeted carefully.

x: 一旦拥有，估值立刻上升。 核心理论 经典实验中，随机拿到杯子的人平均要价约为未拿到者出价的两倍。它可以用损失厌恶解释：卖出被编码为损失。这也带来了「买卖价差」、免费试用转化率高、以及二手交易难以成交等现象。 康奈尔大学杯子实验中，卖家要价中位数 5.25 美元，买家出价中位数 2.25 美元。 免费试用 30 天后退货率低于预期，因为「已经在用」使它变成要失去的东西。
xEn: Owning something immediately raises its perceived value. Core theory In classic experiments, randomly assigned mug owners asked about twice what non-owners offered. Loss aversion explains it: selling is coded as a loss. It also produces buy-sell spreads, high conversion from free trials and sluggish second-hand markets. In the Cornell mug experiment, median willingness to accept was $5.25 versus willingness to pay of $2.25. Free-trial return rates are lower than expected: once in use, giving it back feels like a loss.

x: 各自选择对己最优的策略，结果却对双方都更差。 经典博弈 两名嫌疑人分开审讯，无论对方怎么选，认罪（背叛）都是自己的最优策略，于是双方都认罪并被重判——而如果都沉默，惩罚更轻。这个结构刻画了价格战、军备竞赛、公共资源过度使用与减排谈判等大量现实困境。关键在于：个体理性不等于集体理性。 两家公司都降价抢份额，最终行业利润整体下滑，谁都不比默契维持价格时更好。
xEn: Each player choosing their best response leaves both worse off. Classic games Two suspects interrogated separately both find confessing (defecting) strictly better whatever the other does, so both confess and both get heavier sentences — whereas mutual silence is better. The structure models price wars, arms races, overuse of common resources and climate negotiations. Individual rationality is not collective rationality. Two firms both cut prices to win share; industry profit falls and neither does better than under tacit price discipline.

x: 人人都已选定策略，且无人能靠单方面改变而获益。 核心概念 纳什均衡是博弈解的基本概念，但它既不一定唯一，也不一定高效。多个均衡并存时，「谁先行动、如何沟通、历史与习惯」决定最终落点，这就是「协调问题」。混合策略均衡还意味着理性玩家会主动随机化，让对手无法预测。 键盘布局、充电接口标准、靠左还是靠右行驶，都是「多个均衡中选了一个」的协调结果。
xEn: Everyone has chosen, and no one gains by changing alone. Core concept Nash equilibrium is the basic solution concept, but it need not be unique or efficient. With multiple equilibria, who moves first, how players communicate and history decide the outcome — a coordination problem. Mixed-strategy equilibria imply rational players deliberately randomise to stay unpredictable. Keyboard layouts, charging standards and driving sides are all coordination outcomes among multiple equilibria.

x: 强者去按按钮、弱者坐享其成，也会是稳定结果。 经典博弈 在一个猪圈里，按按钮会带来食物但要付出成本。大猪食量大、抢食能力强，若不按就没得吃；小猪反正抢不过，最佳选择是等在食槽边。结果是「小猪搭便车、大猪承担成本」。这解释了为什么大企业常承担行业公共品（标准、渠道、政策游说），而小企业跟随。 行业龙头发起标准化与合规建设，中小企业直接沿用，成本由龙头承担。
xEn: The strong press the button while the weak free-ride — and that can be stable. Classic games In the boxed-pigs setup, pressing the lever brings food but costs effort. The big pig eats more and must act or starve; the small pig cannot win the scramble and does best waiting. The equilibrium has the small pig free-riding and the big pig bearing cost — mirroring how large firms fund industry public goods while smaller ones follow. A market leader funds standards and compliance work while smaller firms simply adopt them.

x: 收益归个人、成本由群体分担时，资源会被过度使用。 经典博弈 牧场上每户多放一头牛，收益全归自己，草场退化成本由所有人分摊，于是每户都倾向增加放牧直到草场毁掉。这是多人版囚徒困境。出路包括私有权界定、配额与税费、以及奥斯特罗姆记录的自下而上的社区自治规则。 共享单车无约束投放、公海渔业枯竭、地下水超采，都是同一结构。
xEn: When benefits are private and costs shared, resources are overused. Classic games Each herder gains fully from one more animal while degradation costs are shared, so everyone expands until the pasture is ruined: a multi-player prisoner's dilemma. Solutions include privatisation, quotas and taxes, and the bottom-up community rules documented by Ostrom. Unlimited dockless bikes, depleted high-seas fisheries and falling water tables share the same structure.

x: 双方都硬撑到底就会同归于尽，先退让的一方反而「输」。 经典博弈 两车对撞，先转向者被看作胆小鬼。由于让步代价高、相撞代价更高，玩家会用「自断退路」来提升可信度——例如公开承诺、销毁多余产能、让第三方见证。这也解释了危机边缘政策（brinkmanship）与部分贸易与地缘对抗。 谈判中公开宣称「绝不接受低于 X 的方案」，就是主动放弃让步空间，以提高威胁的可信度。
xEn: Both holding firm ends in mutual ruin, yet whoever swerves 'loses'. Classic games Two cars drive at each other; whoever swerves first is the coward. Because conceding is costly but colliding is worse, players raise credibility by removing their own retreat — public commitments, scrapping spare capacity, third-party witnesses. It explains brinkmanship and aspects of trade and geopolitical confrontation. Publicly declaring 'no deal below X' voluntarily removes your room to concede, raising the credibility of your threat.

x: 当博弈会继续下去，合作就能成为稳定策略。 机制 阿克塞尔罗德竞赛显示，「以牙还牙」——首轮合作、之后复制对方上一步——在长期重复博弈中表现极佳：它善意、可报复、可原谅且规则清晰。关键前提是未来足够重要（贴现因子高）、行为可观察、背叛会被惩罚。 同一条街上的老店更讲信用，因为还要长期做邻居；一次性旅游区的宰客则是另一种均衡。
xEn: When the game continues, cooperation can become a stable strategy. Mechanisms Axelrod's tournaments showed tit-for-tat — cooperate first, then mirror the opponent's last move — performs excellently in repeated play: nice, retaliatory, forgiving and clear. The preconditions are that the future matters enough, actions are observable and defection can be punished. Long-standing shops on the same street keep their word because they must live with their neighbours; tourist traps behave differently.

x: 双方各自专注相对成本更低的生产，交换后总产出与总福利都能提高。 比较优势说明：贸易的基础不是「谁更强」，而是「相对机会成本不同」。因此即便一国在所有行业效率都更低，专注相对劣势最小的行业仍可获益。贸易带来的收益是「总量提升」，但内部分配并不均匀——受损者真实存在，因此需要配套调整政策。 两国分别专注自己放弃代价最小的产品并交换，两国可消费的组合都更大。 主流经济学观点 贸易提高总产出、降低价格、扩大选择，长期对多数人有利。 批评与修正 收益分配不均、产业空心化与安全依赖风险真实存在，不能只用总量论证。
xEn: Each side specialises where relative cost is lowest, and exchange raises total output and welfare. Comparative advantage says trade rests not on who is stronger but on differing relative opportunity costs. Even a country less efficient in everything gains by specialising where its relative disadvantage is smallest. The gain is aggregate, but distribution within a country is uneven — losers are real and need adjustment policies. Two countries specialise in what costs them least to forgo, and both can consume a larger bundle. Mainstream view Trade raises output, lowers prices and widens choice, benefiting most people over time. Critiques Uneven distribution, deindustrialisation and security dependence are real, so aggregate arguments alone are insufficient.

x: 关税抬高进口价、保护本国生产者，但成本多由本国消费者与下游企业承担。 关税的直接影响是进口减少、国内价格上升。收益归于受保护的生产者与财政，成本分散到大量消费者与使用进口中间品的企业。若对方报复，出口行业受损；长期还可能推动供应链重构与技术脱钩，代价超出短期贸易额变化。 对进口洗衣机加税后，本国同类产品价格同步上升，消费者实际承担了大部分成本。 支持关税的理由 保护幼稚产业、维护供应链安全、应对不公平补贴与倾销。 反对关税的理由 抬高国内成本、引发报复、保护低效率、最终由本国消费者买单。
xEn: Tariffs raise import prices and shield domestic producers, but domestic consumers and downstream firms usually pay. Tariffs cut imports and raise domestic prices. Benefits accrue to protected producers and the treasury, while costs spread across many consumers and firms using imported inputs. Retaliation hurts exporters, and over time supply chains may be reconfigured and technology decoupled, with costs beyond the headline trade volumes. After tariffs on imported washing machines, domestic prices rose too, so consumers bore much of the cost. Case for Protecting infant industries, securing supply chains, and countering unfair subsidies or dumping. Case against Raising domestic costs, inviting retaliation, protecting inefficiency and ultimately taxing local consumers.

x: 逆差是进口多于出口的表现，本身既不等于「吃亏」，也不能单独判断好坏。 从国民核算看，贸易差额与储蓄—投资差额恒等：国内储蓄低于投资，就需要外部资金流入，表现为贸易逆差。因此逆差与外资流入、消费旺盛或投资旺盛相伴，原因各异。真正值得关注的是债务结构、资金用途与产业竞争力。 一个国家大量进口设备用于扩产，短期逆差扩大但未来产能提升；另一种逆差源于长期借债消费，性质完全不同。 不必恐慌 逆差可反映投资吸引力与全球分工位置，是储蓄投资关系的镜像。 值得警惕 若由持续借债消费驱动，可能积累外债风险与货币脆弱性。
xEn: A deficit means imports exceed exports; on its own it signals neither loss nor gain. In the national accounts the trade balance equals the saving-investment gap: when domestic saving is below investment, foreign capital flows in and a trade deficit appears. Deficits therefore accompany capital inflows, strong consumption or strong investment, for different reasons. What matters is debt structure, use of funds and industrial competitiveness. Importing machinery to expand capacity widens a deficit temporarily; borrowing to fund consumption is a different matter entirely. Not alarming per se A deficit can reflect investment attractiveness and global division of labour: a mirror of the saving-investment balance. Worth watching If driven by debt-financed consumption, it can accumulate external debt risk and currency fragility.

n: 全球产业链的效率与脆弱
x: 精细化分工带来低成本，也把单点故障传导成全球停摆。 准时制生产与单一供应商降低了库存成本，却在疫情、自然灾害或地缘冲突中暴露脆弱性。应对方式包括多元化供应、提高关键库存、近岸外包与友岸外包——每一种都意味着成本上升。因此「效率」与「韧性」本身就是一个取舍。 一颗几元钱的芯片缺货，导致整车厂停产，损失以数十亿计。 效率优先 专业化与规模效应显著降低成本，过度冗余会削弱长期竞争力。 韧性优先 关键领域的断供代价极高，适度冗余是必要的保险费。
nEn: Global Supply Chains: Efficiency and Fragility
xEn: Fine-grained specialisation lowers cost while turning a single failure into a global stall. Just-in-time production and single sourcing cut inventory costs but proved fragile to pandemics, disasters and geopolitics. Responses include supplier diversification, strategic inventory, near-shoring and friend-shoring — each raising cost. Efficiency and resilience are themselves a trade-off. A shortage of a chip costing a few dollars halted car plants, with losses in the billions. Efficiency first Specialisation and scale cut costs sharply; excessive redundancy erodes long-run competitiveness. Resilience first In critical sectors, disruption costs are extreme, so some redundancy is necessary insurance.

x: 本币贬值让出口更便宜、进口更贵，但改善贸易差额需要时间。 汇率变动首先改变相对价格，随后影响数量。由于合同、产能与消费习惯短期内难以调整，贬值初期进口成本上升快、出口数量增加慢，贸易差额可能先恶化，这被称为「J 曲线效应」。汇率也受利率差与资本流动影响，并不总由贸易决定。 本币贬值后出国旅游与进口商品变贵，出口企业订单增加往往要等几个季度。 贬值有利出口 价格竞争力增强，出口数量与就业可能改善。 代价与限制 推高进口成本与输入型通胀，若供应链高度依赖进口则效果有限。
xEn: Depreciation cheapens exports and raises import costs, but the trade balance adjusts only with a lag. Exchange rates move relative prices first and quantities later. Contracts, capacity and habits adjust slowly, so in the early phase import costs rise faster than exports grow and the trade balance may worsen first — the J-curve. Rates also respond to interest differentials and capital flows, not trade alone. After depreciation, overseas travel and imports get pricier while export orders pick up only quarters later. Depreciation helps exports Price competitiveness improves and export volumes and jobs may rise. Costs and limits It raises import costs and imported inflation, and matters little when supply chains depend heavily on imports.

n: 网红店排队两小时，值得吗？
x: 排队是用时间替代价格：当价格被压低，人们就用等待来竞争。 如果店家允许涨价，队伍会自然变短，因为一部分人不愿付更高价；价格受限时，超额需求只能转化为排队、限购或黄牛。排队时间其实就是「看不见的价格」。因此判断值不值得，要看你那两小时的机会成本，而不是别人排不排。
nEn: Is two hours in a queue for a trendy shop worth it?
xEn: Queues substitute time for price: when price is held down, people compete by waiting. If the shop could raise prices the queue would shorten, since some would not pay more; with price constrained, excess demand shows up as queues, purchase limits or scalpers. Waiting time is a hidden price. Whether it is worth it depends on your opportunity cost for those two hours, not on what others do.

n: 大城市的房子为什么这么贵？
x: 高需求叠加供给弹性低：好位置的房子无法复制，供给曲线几乎垂直。 房价由「区位决定的土地价值 + 建造成本 + 预期」共同决定。核心地段的通勤便利、学校与公共服务无法在别处复制，供给受土地与规划限制，因此需求增长主要体现为涨价。这也意味着，只增加远郊供给对核心区价格的缓解作用有限。
nEn: Why is housing in big cities so expensive?
